files.content:
# Pixel Dice Poker

A small offline dice poker game made with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.

## Play

Open `index.html` in a modern browser. Press **Roll dice** to roll five dice. After your first roll, click a die (or focus it and press Enter/Space) to hold or release it, then roll again. You get three total rolls per round. Your current hand is shown after each roll. Select **New round** to reset.

Hand names include pair, two pair, three of a kind, straight, full house, four of a kind, five of a kind, and high die.

All files are local; the game needs no server, packages, network connection, or external assets.
